post_operation: assign negative errno (e.g. status = -ENOMEM) into return-code variable before goto-to-cleanup-label
critical_variable: status (the int return-code variable of multi_bind)
path_conditions: NULL-check failure path of an allocation-style API (usb_otg_descriptor_alloc) that does `goto <cleanup_label>` without first assigning a negative errno to the return-code variable; the cleanup label later returns that variable, so the caller sees 0 (success) on failure
